$comment: attention.mention_growth@1.0.0 — source §8.1: mention_growth = mention_delta / max(mentions_prior, 1). Hand-computed; every case chosen to divide evenly, no tolerance needed.

cases.name: at_floor_exactly
cases.why: prior mentions == min_mentions (5) exactly — the off-by-one boundary, computed not abstained.

cases.name: below_prior_floor
cases.why: §4.1: prior mentions < 5 ⇒ hide growth, show absolute delta instead.

abstention.message: The prior window had 3 mention(s). At least 5 are required before growth is shown as a ratio, because a ratio over a handful of mentions swings enormously for a change of one or two. The absolute change (attention.mention_delta) is shown instead.
